bullets.text: In Anuppampattu near Ponneri, a spotted deer and two cows died from a low-hanging electricity wire, and the office must monitor local infrastructure safety.
Near Poonamallee, thirty people contracted dengue and a young boy lost his life, so the office should track health department interventions in the area.
Residents in Goundar Palayam near Minjur complained about damaged electricity poles during rains, and the office should coordinate repairs with the electricity board.
An elderly couple staged a protest at the Avadi sub-registrar office alleging officials aided a twenty-five crore land grab, and the office should investigate the grievance.
An electricity consumer grievance meeting is scheduled in Periyakuppam, Thiruvallur, and the office should track the proceedings and citizen complaints.
Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong and Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay inaugurated a CapitaLand Data Centre in Chennai, and the portfolio team should highlight this investment.
MeitY launched three indigenous AI models named EKA-1, Dhir 2B and Dhir 5B, and the office should monitor their secure deployment across state sectors.
StartupTN Chairman Singai G. Ramachandran stated that women lead over fifty percent of registered startups in Tamil Nadu, and the ministry should support this growth.
